```
SKU -> SKU_ID -> Entitlement
redwood-hosted-v1 -> RHV1 -> usage, per-token
redwood-dedicated-monthly -> RDM1 -> reserved-capacity, monthly
redwood-hosted-trial -> RHT1 -> trial 14d
```
Anita: LGTM. We'll need pricing tiers for EU vs US (VAT). Finance/ops will want tax class.
